travismac78: "You're late," said the corporal when Albin Travismac arrived on Day 3. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Albin Travismac saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

The salvo walked along S-F5 and caught Albin Travismac in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos. A letter from home reached Albin Travismac before dusk. Albin Travismac read it twice and slept a little easier.
No bed for Albin Travismac yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
